title: Liquid Roller
description: A liquid drum and bass track in F minor at 175 BPM, 84 bars (about 1 minute 55): a chopped two-step break, a round sub bass, electric piano chords, an FM pad and a vibraphone melody over Fm9, Dbmaj7, Abmaj7 and Eb(add9). The drums are a sample: a two-bar break loop from the Break Loops sample pack (a rendered loop, 175 BPM, stored in the state of the Loop Slicer), cut into 16 equal slices and re-sequenced by a Pattern Tracker with the patterns of the Loop Slicer Break Chops tunes. The song tempo equals the tempo of the break, so every slice plays at its own speed; swing is 0 because the groove is in the break. Intro, build, drop 1, break, build 2, drop 2 and outro. Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
